entities.summary: Turkish, a notable figure in the history of Greece, associated with Postwar Greece and the Military Junta (1967–1974). Preceded by Military coup establishes the Colonels' junta in Greece and Postwar Reconstruction and Political Instability. Their legacy influenced Athens Polytechnic uprising crushed by tanks; junta's legitimacy collapses and Greece joins the European Economic Community.
